meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在 NanoClaw 群组中建立一个持久的维基知识库。它会根据 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，帮你整理和存储信息，并支持添加、查询和维护操作。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base”、“llm wiki”或“karpathy wiki”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个关于机器学习的维基。
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择群组并设计维基结构。

say.text: 把这份PDF加入我的维基知识库。
say.note: Claude 会逐文件处理并更新维基页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, it helps organize and store information, supporting ingest, query, and maintenance operations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", or "karpathy wiki".

say_en.text: Add a wiki about machine learning.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to choose a group and design the wiki.

say_en.text: Add this PDF to my wiki knowledge base.
say_en.note: Claude will process files one by one and update wiki pages.
